mentions.name: agent-gui
mentions.description: An agent client GUI built with Python and Tkinter to run on old, low-end laptops such as the ASUS 1005HA, with plans to power it using a local LLM (Llama-3-8B via llama.cpp) running on a 4070 GPU.
mentions.problem: Python builds are slow on old low-end laptop hardware; compiling the Python wheels took hours on an ASUS 1005HA.
mentions.source_excerpt:
For the old computer talk above this is the project, can see I did make an agent client (although a poor one) using Tkinter since the ASUS 1005HA was able to compile the python wheels (although it took a few hours).

I'm also going to use a local LLM I have a 4070 so I can run like Llama-3-8B through llama.cpp

https://github.com/jdc-cunningham/agent-gui
